`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales, and the 6 lives at the top as `LEAD_TIME_DAYS`.

Running it on the current `inventory.csv` flags two items that used to show `ok`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has about 3.75 days left (9 on hand at 2.4 a day) and oat milk has 4 days (30 at 7.5 a day). Items with nothing on the shelf still show `OUT`.

An item with exactly 6 days of stock is not flagged, since on paper it lasts until the delivery arrives. That leaves no cushion for a busy day or a late delivery; if you want one, bump `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8.
